expected.summary: Confirmed with its token (two-step), the job runs NC drill, ODB++ and Gerber and writes the package with centroid, BOM, README and manifest into {dir}/fab, every file recorded with its size and SHA-256.

rows.reason: pcb export always writes a whole package into a new or empty folder; there is no call with nothing to write.

expected.summary: The session has no such board open.
A Designer and a Layout are both running (the usual state once the board exists), and the call names neither --session nor --doc: E_AMBIGUOUS lists both instances with their documents.

An earlier pcb export of this board was stopped by ending its worker process (Task Manager) while it ran, so its outcome is unknown and its operation keeps the board's Output folder locked until operation resolve: this second export gets E_CONFLICT target_locked.
Run under a scope file that does not cover the target ({dir}/fab and the board's Output folder); nothing is previewed to the application's files or sent.

While a forward-annotation run or pcb export job of this tool runs in Layout, the session reports busy or unresponsive. Only --session is given: Layout does not say which board it has open while it does not answer, and a --doc it cannot match would be E_NOT_FOUND.

A person leaves a modal dialog open in Layout before the call, such as Setup > Setup Parameters or Help > About. Layout may go on answering COM, so a dialog box over it, or a Layout that stops answering, is reported as the session blocked with the dialog's title; E_HUMAN_REQUIRED with action dismiss_dialog and a resume command. Only --session is given, since a Layout that stops answering does not say which board it has open.
The call returns the job (exit 0); Layout lost during an Output command ends the job failed with the package not written and persistence partial, which job get reports as ok false.

rows.unrunnable: The COM connection to Layout cannot be cut on demand at the moment of a call; driver tests D06 and D21 cover how the runtime handles a lost connection.

expected.summary: The board holds unsaved changes; confirmed, the job writes the package into the empty folder {dir}/fab-unsaved as usual, and the board stays unsaved.

Confirmed: the job's worker waits before its read-back, and meanwhile {dir}/fab-mismatch/bom.csv is deleted (--tamper). The check of the job's files finds it missing, and the job ends with E_VERIFY_FAILED.
